main_text.head: Proœmium.
main_text.p: Studium, majus ingenium, otium, gratiám-que, & potest de Cantico Canticorum probabilius aliquid dicere, non invideo, non aspernor, quin potius cupio ab eo discere quod ignoro, & libenter me discipulum profitebor, dummodo doceat, & non detrahat ; nihil e-nim tam facile, quàm otiosum & dormien-tem de aliorum labore ac vigiliis disputare. Idem dictum volo de aliis scripturæ libris quorum Literalem explicationem, vel jam typis mandavi, vel deinceps, Deo juvante, sum man-daturus.
main_text.head: Explicatio

page.notes: The strip at the right edge of the scan (short italic letters in a vertical column) is the edge of the facing page and is not transcribed. The two horizontal rules are printed rules, not text. The heading "Explicatio" is set in italic at the right, so it is marked as a level 2 heading.
